summary: Activation by onLanguage:typescript is modeled end to end and activate() runs once in eh1 (seam scenario passes). Opening a .ts file never reaches it: the language service's onDidRequestRichLanguageFeatures -> activateByEvent('onLanguage:<id>') and bare 'onLanguage' (languageService.ts:287-291) is not modeled.

Corrected: '*' is activated eagerly by the extension host itself in _startExtensionHost -> _handleEagerExtensions (extHostExtensionService.ts:671-686, 800-820), before onStartupFinished, not by the renderer after startup. Model reproduces the exact path. World note: fixtures omit git's vscode.git-base dependency.

Throw is caught into a FailedExtension, $onExtensionActivationError reported (console only in a built product), host keeps running, markdown still activates. Minor wrong claim: renderer activation_errors state is telemetry only in code.

Made precise: 5 min window, limit 3; crashes 1-2 auto-restart with a 5 s status and replay requested events; the 3rd prompts Bisect/Restart/Learn More and stays stopped. Model reproduces all of it, including re-activation in the new host.

Corrected: unresponsive = no ack for 3 s checked every 1 s (not ~10 s); the reaction is ExtensionsAutoProfiler (profile 5 s, conditional SILENT prompt, no restart offer). Detection modeled correctly; auto-profiler reaction missing. Sim: late callee's emit delivered before its virtual time.

Made precise: no save except isRefactoring + files.refactoring.autoSave + >1 resource (bulkEditService.ts:272-274). Model crosses RPC to BulkEditService, resolves/edits the text model, leaves it dirty, no write; the refactoring variant saves both files.

ExtHostCommands -> $executeCommand(retry, []) -> ICommandService is right, but the save handler file-commands.cmd-workbench-action-files-save reads input.resource while the command service passes {args, command_id}: run aborts. Edit: handler should resolve the active editor when args are empty. Control with saveFiles passes.

Corrected: extensions with untrustedWorkspaces.supported=false are DisabledByTrustRequirement and never registered (git, TS); markdown ('limited') still activates; banner shows; startup modal not shown (startupPrompt default never). Model activates git and TS in restricted mode (no trust filtering in extension-service.initialize) and has no banner behavior; world registry lacks the capability.
Activation in w1 reaches only eh1; w2 activation goes to eh2, not a cache hit; per-instance registries and activators are separate.
